definitions.explanation: General term for tools used for writing, including pens, pencils, mechanical pencils, and markers. Frequently seen in exam instructions and school supply lists.

examples.japanese: {筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}を{持参|じさん}してください。
examples.english: Please bring your own writing utensils.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}には{筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}と{消|け}しゴムが{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: Writing utensils and an eraser are needed for the exam.

examples.japanese: {受付|うけつけ}で{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}こうとしたが、{筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}を{忘|わす}れてしまった。
examples.english: I tried to write my name at the reception desk, but I had forgotten my writing utensils.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal compound noun formed from {筆記|ひっき} (writing) + {用具|ようぐ} (tools, equipment). Very common in official instructions such as exam guidelines, seminar notices, and school supply lists. In casual speech, people are more likely to say ペン or {鉛筆|えんぴつ} for specific items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}を{持参|じさん}する (to bring writing utensils)
- {筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}{一式|いっしき} (a complete set of writing utensils)
- {筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}を{忘|わす}れる (to forget one's writing utensils)
